localChanges: Pressing Ctrl, Cmd or Alt with a key is now left to the browser: Ctrl+R no longer builds a road behind the reload question, Ctrl+F no longer fortifies, and Ctrl+T or Ctrl+C no longer toggle the map or recentre it. With Caps Lock on, p and d no longer pillage or disband: only Shift picks the capital letter. Letting go of Shift between Shift+5 and Shift+6 no longer breaks the sequence (closes #479).
